response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune, f.rebtotal, f.rebrate, f.feerate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate FROM matched), grouped AS (SELECT orderslink, ordertune, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_relative_gap FROM matched GROUP BY orderslink, ordertune) SELECT g.orderslink, g.ordertune AS order_type, g.avg_rebate, g.avg_relative_gap, g.avg_rebate - b.avg_rebate AS rebate_excess FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE g.avg_rebate > b.avg_rebate ORDER BY rebate_excess DESC LIMIT 10;
